# Aevum Labs — full description

Aevum Labs is an independent product studio. "Aevum" is Latin for a lifetime or an
age; the studio's theme is longevity — software made to last, engineered to endure
rather than just to launch. It is based in Nairobi, Kenya, and its products are
built for the real world (messy data, unreliable networks) yet used worldwide.
Home: https://aevumlabs.site  ·  Contact: support@zaamu.com

## Principles
- Built to last — clean code, few dependencies, products still shippable years on.
- Built for the real world — if it doesn't hold up on a Nairobi 3G connection, it isn't done.
- Privacy by default — PesaScope never uploads your statement; Sampuli invents data that belongs to no one.
- Small team, high craft — each product designed and built end to end.

## Products

### Zaamu — https://zaamu.com
A booking platform for barbershops, salons and spas. Any shop can self-onboard,
publish a booking page, and manage staff, services and appointments — walk-ins and
online bookings in a single calendar, with receptionist roles, no-show protection
and reminders. Multi-tenant; free while growing. Also on iOS and Android.

### Mezani — https://mezani.health
A calm, pantry-aware meal planner for households. Plan the week's meals, roll every
ingredient into one shopping list, and keep a pantry the whole household can trust.
Free for every household. Web, iOS and Android.

### Sampuli — https://sampuli.site
Format-true synthetic test data for software teams: 90 country packs covering
phones, national IDs, tax numbers, bank/SWIFT details, payment cards (Luhn-valid),
and more — every value format-correct but belonging to no real person. Three ways
to use it:
- In the browser at https://sampuli.site
- As the npm package `@sampuli/data` (also a CLI: `npx @sampuli/data`)
- Via a free, keyless, CORS-open REST API at https://sampuli.site/api/v1
  (e.g. `GET /api/v1/ke/person?n=3`, or `/api/v1/batch?specs=ng.phone,ke.person:3,de.company`)
There is also an MCP server for AI agents. Sampuli is the part of the portfolio an
agent can query directly for data.

### PesaScope — https://pesascope.site
Reads Safaricom's password-protected "M-PESA Full Statement" PDF entirely in the
browser and turns it into a spending dashboard: who you pay most, where money goes,
regular payments, fees — reconciled to the cent against the statement's own totals.
Nothing is uploaded; the file never leaves the device.
